summary: Toyota Motor Corporation filed a Form 6-K reporting a partial amendment to its existing share-based compensation plan for senior employees, which uses an ESOP trust structure. The amendment modifies vesting dates and adds a provision for cash settlement in lieu of shares for non-Japanese resident employees. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event is involved. This is a routine plan administration update. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16 and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
